title: 怀旧与进步
text:
我们是否在飞速奔向未来的同时，遗忘了来时的路？在这个数字化浪潮席卷全球的时代，人们习惯于追求极致的效率。智能设备取代了书信，算法决定了阅读的范围。这种变革无疑提升了生活质量，却也悄然剥离了某种温情。
许多人开始怀念旧时光，并非因为过去更完美，而是渴望那份纯粹。那时的人们愿意花时间等待，懂得在慢节奏中感受生活。现在的社会节奏过快，导致个体容易产生焦虑感。当所有事物都被量化为数据，情感的深度往往被忽略。
然而，过度沉溺于过去并非良策。进步是不可逆转的历史趋势，也是解决现实问题的关键。医疗技术的突破挽救无数生命，交通的便捷缩短了地理距离。如果拒绝现代化，社会将陷入停滞。
真正的成熟应当是寻找平衡点。我们应当在拥抱科技的同时，有意识地保留人文精神。这意味着在高效办公之余，给家人留出高质量的陪伴时间。在依赖网络社交之余，尝试面对面地深度交流。
怀旧不应成为阻碍前进的枷锁，而应化为前行的精神动力。它提醒我们，无论时代如何变迁，某些核心价值不可缺失。尊重传统与追求创新并不矛盾。
将历史的厚度与现代的速度结合，才能构建更完整的文明。唯有如此，我们才能在快节奏的现代生活中，依然保有内心的宁静。这才是进步应有的真正含义。

questions.prompt: According to the text, why do many people begin to miss the "old days"?
options: Because the past was objectively better in every way
Because they yearn for the purity of that time, not because the past was actually more perfect
It is purely random nostalgia with no real explanation
Because the past had superior technology

questions.prompt: What examples does the text give of real benefits brought by progress and modernization?
options: Higher taxes and stricter regulations
Medical breakthroughs saving lives and transportation shortening distances
Reduced average life expectancy
Increased isolation between people

questions.prompt: According to the text, what should nostalgia transform into, rather than becoming a shackle hindering progress?
options: A legal restriction on new technology
A reason to reject all forms of change
A spiritual motivation for moving forward
A purely commercial marketing tool

questions.prompt: What practical suggestion does the text give for balancing technology with humanistic spirit?
options: Completely abandoning all modern technology
Giving family high-quality companionship time even amid efficient work
Working longer hours to afford more devices
Avoiding contact with family to focus on career

questions.prompt: According to the text's conclusion, are respecting tradition and pursuing innovation contradictory?
options: Yes, one must always be sacrificed for the other
The text avoids taking a position on this question
No — combining historical depth with modern speed builds a more complete civilization
They are contradictory only in developing countries

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.
